title: Mixed Event — An Unmissable Spirited Affair

meta.Outline: Kamiyama High School's second-years are headed to Kyoto! In contrast with Tsukasa's excitement for their school trip, Rui is less enthused. But will his feelings change when one of his classmates approaches him?

rows.Line: Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'd like to see if it'll work in our show. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: O-Okay...? Limbo in a bamboo forest...? Yes, I agree that it goes with this particular scene, but it's also starting to turn into some sort of comedic skit...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! Look at the time!
Our lunch break's almost over!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, we should start heading back.
If I remember correctly, next is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A long homeroom.
All classes will be having a discussion about the school trip.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you already know what's going to happen?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh heh heh! I am a class representative after all! The teachers told me the other day about how we'd be doing this soon!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I see. That makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Still, the school trip...
I hope this discussion doesn't take too long.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I thought you'd be looking forward to it more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well...
I am in the sense that we get to go somewhere that we normally don't...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But people don't usually like it when I try to put on a show during a school trip. I've even been scolded before for just making a few props in the hotel.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I had a feeling in the back of my mind, but you really are a creature of habit...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I appreciate the fact that you love putting on shows wherever and whenever, but why not try doing something else for a change?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You only get one chance in life as a high schooler to go on this trip! It's like a one-night-only performance!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Like a one-night-only performance...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Precisely! So, I think you should enjoy this trip as—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
Rui, we need to go now or we're going to be late!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Enjoying the school trip...
I did have fun when I participated in the sports festival...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I'm less sure about this.)
Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: That concludes our overview.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, three days and two nights in Kyoto...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Days one and three involve sightseeing with our groups, while we have day two to ourselves. That seems fairly standard...)

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: We will now be forming our groups. We're free to choose whoever, but we're limited to groups of four.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Groups of four...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Based on the explanation we just heard, we'll be doing most things with our groupmates, including sleeping in the same room.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Alright, we're all set!

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: Yeah, the gang's all here!

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line: Can't we have a group of five...?

rows.Speaker: Female Student B
rows.Line: Or could we split into a two and a three? Oh, wanna ask the class rep to see if we can have a group of five?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Everyone already seems to know who they want to group with...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I've been able to talk to more of my classmates since the sports festival, but I'm not sure who'd want me in their group for this trip...)
Hey, uh... Kamishiro, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, you're...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
It's Miyake!
I helped with the equipment during the sports festival... But enough of that. I'm here to ask...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Do you wanna join our group?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
W-Wait, uhh...! I'm sorry!
I know I probably seem like a complete stranger to you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, it's not that...
But... Why me?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Actually, I've been meaning to chat with you for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With me...?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Yeah, 'cause I like gadgets and stuff too.
The drones you make are so cool.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: But I sorta never got the opportunity until now, you know? That's why I thought I should take this chance to get to know you better.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Also, there are two others already besides me. Hayashi and Taniyama are their names, over there by the wall. You'd be our fourth!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, are you talking about those two...?

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
Hey, he's looking this way...
I guess Miyake's having trouble getting Kamishiro to join us...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Does this mean he needs backup?!
If so, I'll go help!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They certainly seem like a fun bunch.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: H-Haha. Sorry, I know this is all happening really suddenly... It's also probably pretty obvious that I'm not exactly the outgoing type, so... I-If you don't want to join us, we'll understand!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: But it would be nice to have you in our group, Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I appreciate the invitation.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'd be more than happy to join.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
R-Really...?!
Thanks so much!!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Hey, guys!
Kamishiro said he'd join!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I didn't think that anyone would invite me...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
This feels so strange for some reason.)
After school
School Gate

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Rui!
Is your class all finished?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello, Tsukasa. Thank you for waiting. Now, let's head over to the Wonder Stage and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm?
Where's Nene?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, she just sent me a message saying that we should go on ahead without her because her teacher asked for her help with something.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: More importantly, how did that discussion go with your class? In our class, we decided our groups already...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, so did we.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To my surprise, a classmate asked me to join his group. He said he wanted to take this opportunity to get to know me better.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Why so surprised...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: N-No, it's just...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're apparently known as the “Explosive Mad Scientist” to some people, so I wasn't sure if anyone would invite you into their group...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, that's not a very nice nickname...
I'm just a humble director.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Um, I'm not sure a “humble director” would run so many experiments at school that end in explosions...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, Rui, congratulations!
I hope you and your new friends have a fun trip!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't want to raise my expectations too high, but I am sort of looking forward to spending time with them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, excellent!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, also.
Do you already have plans for the second day? We're free to do whatever we like.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The second day?
No, not yet...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, then!
Why don't we do some sightseeing together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're free to mingle with students from other classes, and there's something I'd like to see with you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it's called the “Hyakki Yako Parade”, as in “Night Parade of One Hundred Spirits”. It takes place somewhere a little way away from downtown... Oh, this website has a good explanation.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You get to watch as people walk in a parade while dressed as monsters and spirits from folklore!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Interesting... “All are free to participate and dress up.” Yes, this does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: See what I mean?! The costumes some of these people make are unbelievable! Professional designers also usually take part, so I'm sure you'll find some inspiration for our shows!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It's usually me that people have pegged as the show enthusiast, but your fanaticism for shows also seems to know no bounds.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, I would very much like to see this parade.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wonderful!
Then, we'll go see this during day two!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's also somewhere else that I'm hoping to visit! We'll need to go there before the parade if we can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, where?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: None other than the Kiyomizu Stage!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, Kiyomizu-dera Temple is part of a World Heritage Site after all... But why are you so interested in it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't tell me it's because it has “Stage” in the name...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's exactly right!
It is the duty of a future star such as myself to stand on the biggest stages in the world!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd expect no less from you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Sightseeing with classmates I don't normally interact with, and seeing that parade with Tsukasa...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This school trip is looking to be more fun than I was initially expecting.)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Students who wish to do the tour of Kiyomizu-dera Temple are supposed to gather here, right, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, this should be the right place.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's nice how our school's okay with us joining tours and stuff with students from different classes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm so glad this trip doesn't conflict with work or anything. So, let's try to have as much fun as we... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh... Hello, Hinomori, Momoi.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you two here for the Kiyomizu-dera Temple tour?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, we are!
I'm so glad to see you here, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But you're all by yourself.
Did your friends choose something else?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, they went for traditional crafts...
Unfortunately, that group reached full capacity, so I decided to drop out. Also, I feel that I should see Kiyomizu-dera Temple at least once during my life.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I know...!
Why don't we go sightseeing together as a group? What do you think, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! How does that sound, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind having me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Of course!
The three of us going on a trip together.
I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This school trip is going to be so wonderful!
School trip - Day one
Kyoto

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Okay, we'll be breaking into our groups now! Then, find the bus associated with your respective tour!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Two and a half hours by bullet train...
But we're finally here.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Guys!
The bus for the temples and shrines tour is this way!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Oh, we get to start with Kinkaku-ji Temple!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
I can't wait!
Alright, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Whoa!
I can't believe it's actually golden!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Kinkaku-ji, the Temple of the Golden Pavilion. Its official name is apparently Hokuzan Rokuon Zenji Temple, and it's supposed to evoke a sort of paradise on earth...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you'd only see a golden temple in a place like that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehehe.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
What's up, Kamishiro?
You seem pretty happy about something...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I was just imagining what it'd be like to use this temple as a stage. It'd be quite extravagant, no...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can see it already. It's the last remaining haven on the planet, and it explodes during the final scene.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: What?! You want it to explode?!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Whoa... He really is the Explosive Mad Scientist. I'd never think of something like that.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Hmm... As inappropriate as that sounds, watching this temple explode does seem kinda fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, you think so too?

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna see it happen since I love it when stuff explodes during movies!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I guess great minds do think alike.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: But what would that story be about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, there are a few novels with Kinkaku-ji Temple in it, but this story would be nothing like any of those...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My story would likely fall under science fiction. A golden temple representing a paradise where the masses flock... Yes, that's not a bad start...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, pardon me...
I couldn't help but think out loud.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: No, that's all good.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: I can tell that you really love coming up with shows, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
To be fair, I get so overzealous sometimes that I lose sight of the world around me.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
Hmm...
So, what's wrong with that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I think it's great that you're so passionate about something!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Just look at my favorite anime director. He became able to come up with these amazing works because he was so obsessed with drawing scenes where buildings collapse and stuff. I think you're like him, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Oh, but if you're about to miss the bus or something because you spaced out, we'll have to drag you by the scruff of your neck.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
How? Kamishiro's way too tall for that.
We could maybe do that to Miyake since he's so skinny.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
What?! There's no way you could!
Right, Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehehe...
It may be fun to test that theory out later.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: This is a shrine dedicated to a deity of education. Oh, one of the wish placards says, “I'm gonna get accepted!”

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Entrance exams are the last thing I wanna think about...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: In that sense, Kamishiro, you're really lucky since you always score super high on tests and stuff. I bet you won't have to work very hard to get into most schools.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, which means...
I'll be able to focus on my shows instead of having to worry about exams.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
N-No fair!
You could be a little more modest!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Haha. I only speak the truth.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, this must be a traditional rock garden.
It's much more beautiful than in the pictures.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The boulders represent islands and the lines in the sand represent waves in the water. This must've been how the people of old depicted otherworldly realms.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Yeah, that's kinda cool when you put it that way. This place is so calm and sooth—

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: A-A-Achoo!!!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Hey, so much for calm and soothing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Haha...!
That did sort of turn this place's atmosphere on its head.
Inn

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That hot spring was very refreshing.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But we're probably gonna work up a sweat again because it's so hot out today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I recommend using one of these.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Oh, it's a handheld fan...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it is.
But it doesn't just blow air.
When you press this switch...
se_event_pandemonium_2023_013

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Whoa! What's it blowing out?!
Is this...snow?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's based on an old device that I made for a show when I was looking for a way to make it snow. I succeeded at miniaturizing it, and decided to bring it along since I saw that it was going to be warm here.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: That's incredible, Kamishiro...! You really are a wiz with gadgets!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Man, that hot spring felt great!
Oh, Miyake, you guys are back already?

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: We should probably start getting our beds ready... But it seems like a waste to go to sleep now. Wanna play something?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, how about cards...?

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Ah, a time-honored school trip tradition!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Oh, let's make things interesting!
The loser has to...go outside and buy juice from a vending machine somewhere!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. A game of cards with a little twist...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
But we're not supposed to leave after dark.
What if the teachers find out?

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Don't be such a goody two-shoes!
That's the best part of it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree. That does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: You're on their side, Kamishiro...?!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
You guys ready to play?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yeah, let's get started!
se_event_pandemonium_2023_014

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: A pair of kings! No one's gonna top that...!
se_event_pandemonium_2023_015

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I can. A pair of aces.
That's it for me.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
You're the president, Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
No...!
You didn't cheat, did you?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
I was so sure I'd win...
At least I get to be vice president again. Done.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: No... At this rate, I'm gonna be forced to go buy juice...! I've gotta turn this around somehow...
se_event_pandemonium_2023_018

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Is someone outside our door?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Rui, are you there?!
se_event_pandemonium_2023_018

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Tsukasa, is that you?
se_event_pandemonium_2023_011

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Oh, it's Weirdo One!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: What's up, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I came to see what you're up to...
But good! You seem to be behaving yourself!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was stopped by one of the teachers while I was making my way over to the baths.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They asked, “Your partner in crime isn't up to anything, is he?” As much as I hate being treated like one of the usual suspects, I stopped by just to make sure.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, you seem to just be playing an ordinary game of cards! All's quiet here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Oh, Tenma, wait up...!
Wanna play with us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, a game of cards sounds like fun!
What were you playing just now?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Oh, we were playing President.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I'm quite good at that!
You shall see why I'm called President Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Nice, Tsukasa's in!
That means our initial bet's off since we're starting over!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: What?! How's that fair?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We have a bet in place where the person who finished last the most times after five rounds has to go get juice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I am a future star!
“Last” is not a part of my vocabulary!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I think I know where this is going.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let's begin!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nooo!
I'm the beggar again?! How?!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Awesome! Not last!
Alright, Tenma, you're getting juice for us!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: I can't believe how quickly that came back around...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr...!
As frustrating as this is, I must admit defeat...! I'll go get them now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you like me to go with you, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Why's that?
Won't we stand out if we go together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I want to see your walk of sh—
I mean, see you embark on this brave endeavor.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! You're enjoying this, aren't you?!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: I say go. It'll be more interesting that way.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yeah! I mean, everyone's been wondering if the Weirdo Wombo Combo's gonna try to pull something during this trip!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't encourage him!
Also, Rui, quit trying to follow me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, stop laughing! And quit following me!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Things really are fun when these two are together.
The next morning
School trip - Day two

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yawn... I'm still pretty sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My legs still hurt from having to sit on my feet after getting caught. Honestly, this is going to haunt me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it's time to get back to business!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Because this is day two!
We're free to spend the day however we like!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Today, we'll be visiting Kiyomizu-dera Temple, and then seeing the Hyakki Yako Parade, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's the plan!
We'll also have some time before the parade to look for souvenirs!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Understood.
Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Miyake and the others said that they'd like to meet up before the parade begins. Would you mind them joining us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They sounded very interested after I told them that I'd be seeing it with you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
The more the merrier I say!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, you all chatted up a storm during our game of cards last night! I can say now that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You've made some wonderful new friends, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm also glad.
It's been quite a while since I had fun with my classmates like that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, here's the bus for Kiyomizu-dera Temple!
Let's get on, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay.
Kiyomizu-dera Temple

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow☆ This place is amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<But, is this really a stage?
Aren't there seats for the audience somewhere?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, no seats are necessary.
Especially since this is where one is supposed to perform for the temple's principal image.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The principal... Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A statue of a very wise person who lived long ago and reached a state of pure enlightenment. It's over there. You face towards it when you perform.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Cool!
So you get to do shows for a statue!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! And if you look over there, you get a spectacular view of all of Kyoto!

rows.Speaker: Len, Rin & Miku
rows.Line: <Wooow!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thank you for agreeing to Miku and the others' request during your trip, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's my pleasure.
Please let us know if there's anything you'd like to see as well, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I appreciate the offer...
But...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We should probably head back soon since there's quite a crowd here. We wouldn't want any of them to see us by accident.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah.
Rui, we want you and Tsukasa to have lots and lots of fun!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<What he said!
Oh, but you guys have to tell us all about what you did later♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<What she said!
So, enjoy your trip, you two!
We hope you make lots of fun memories together☆>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you.
We'll see you again in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay♪ Bye bye!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was brief, but I'm glad we had a chance to show Miku and the others what Kyoto looks like.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As am I! I'm sure we'll have plenty of stories to tell them, but we should get them some of those famed mutsuhashi as a little gift!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

Airi, Asahina, look!
It's so big!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That voice I just heard sounded awfully familiar...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, it's very beautiful.
I can see why this is a World Heritage Site. The temple looks so solidly built.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And this view!
Wait, are you taking another video?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'm going to tell Minori and the others all about how our trip's going and... Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
The screen just went black...
I wonder what happened.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh?
Hang on... Don't tell me you've only been taking videos since this morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, is that bad?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course it's bad!
Your battery's probably totally drained!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I brought a portable charger for this trip, but I unfortunately lent it to another classmate this morning... Do you happen to have one, Momoi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, I left mine behind.
I didn't think we'd be streaming or anything...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wh-What should I do...?!
Minori sounded so excited about hearing how our trip is going...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Alright, I'll take a few videos here and there for you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You will?!
Thank you so much, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That means I need to remember as much as I can about what we see and do so I can tell Minori and the others later...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you're...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I thought it was you, Shizuku! Your mask threw me off at first...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, with Airi Momoi in tow!
Oh, and you... We met during Shibuya Festa and New Year's...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Her name's Asahina, Tsukasa.
What brings you all to Kyoto?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
We're here for our school trip.
Are you two as well, Kamishiro...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What...?!
Miya Girls is also here for a school trip?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What a coincidence...!
I never thought we'd see you two here, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You two must be very close to call each other by your first names.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, because our little sisters are incredibly close!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still... Hehe. This is quite the chance encounter.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you all know where you'll be visiting next?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're free until the tour we signed up for this afternoon, so the three of us were thinking about visiting the shrine for the performing arts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's a shrine for the performing arts...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's supposed to be dedicated to the deity of entertainment and the performing arts. Shizuku and I are idols after all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We invited Asahina to join us and she said yes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A shrine for the performing arts you say?! That sounds wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you two have plans after this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were planning on walking around and buying some souvenirs for now. Later this evening, we'll be seeing a parade called the Hyakki Yako Parade where people dress up as folkloric spirits!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Folkloric spirits...?
That sounds interesting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree...!
I'd like to see it since it sounds like a wonderful event to see in Kyoto.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've set aside some time this evening to go buy souvenirs, so we could conceivably join you guys.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Shizuku, your group is about to visit that shrine... And our group will be seeing the parade later tonight...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why don't we do both together?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, you think we should merge groups...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! Us meeting feels like more than just a coincidence! So, would you mind if we joined you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, if you'd like some privacy, we'll understand.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I don't think we mind...
But weren't you guys gonna go look for souvenirs?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Not a problem.
We seem to have given ourselves more time than we needed to see Kiyomizu-dera Temple, so we can just see what's available along the way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then, let's go together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, also... Some friends will be joining us for the parade if that's alright with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today, we're just students here to enjoy our school trip. Let's just try to have fun!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. It looks like this will be a fun day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then, we're set to go!
Thank you, Shizuku, Asahina, Airi Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure thing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, why are you only calling me by my full name?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, so... Saki always used to shout, “It's Happy Everyday!” whenever she saw you, so I began remembering that as your name...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In order to overwrite that, I've made it a habit to call you by your full name. I apologize if that feels awkward in any way...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
O-Oh, I had no idea...
In that case, I don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you, Airi Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, keep your voice down!
Have you forgotten that I'm an idol?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Honestly, Tenma, it feels like I'm on a variety show whenever I talk to you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, thank you all for having us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Likewise, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's have as much fun as we can today!
Kyoto

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's head to the shrine for the performing arts!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, before we do, mind if we take a quick detour?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Where, Momoi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Between here and the shrine, there's supposed to be a big street with lots of shops... We should be able to buy souvenirs and have a quick tea break.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, would that be okay?
It'll also give you two a chance to find some souvenirs like you said.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great!
Then, we'll start with the street of souvenir shops!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wow...!
So many shops...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Let's see... Based on this map, there's a souvenir shop on the street just ahead, with a little tea shop further along.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that bulletin says a new Japanese sweet shop apparently just opened up in the area where the tea shop is. It seems very popular.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Japanese sweets?!
That's definitely going on the list...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, we gotta check it out later and–

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
These candies look like gemstones!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, these could work very well as a stage prop if we made a ring using some. I can see it already... The king eats his own ring as he goes mad with power...

rows.Speaker: Airi & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you can try this mochi?
Then, I'd like a sample!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, don't wander off without us!
Have you forgotten that your phone's out of battery?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, a textile shop.
It'd be nice to make some costumes out of these fabrics someday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, that goes for you too!
Don't wander off like that!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is turning into quite a lively day...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's find some souvenirs for our nearest and dearest!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Mutsuhashi are pretty standard...
But I kinda want to get something more fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, how about these?
Grapefruit-flavored mutsuhashi gummies!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grapefruit-flavored mutsuhashi gummies?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's quite the combination...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess this kind of tragedy is what happens when the tourism industry goes a little too far...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But they could be worth getting.
Emu likes these sorts of strange snacks, and Nene likes grapefruit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That doesn't justify buying these!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena might like some of these blotting sheets...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're getting those for her, Asahina?
Then, I think I'll get this powder puff...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It would've been nice to also run into Ena here since we're all second years.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's sorta doubtful since night school students don't have their trip at the same time as regular students.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we should take this opportunity to get her some nice gifts!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not seeing one anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What are you looking for, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, one of those golden Kyoto figurines...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Golden Kyoto figurines...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you mean one of those porcelain dolls made in Kyoto, but colored gold...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, what are you talking about?!
There's no way they make those!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's unfortunate... I've searched for them everywhere to no avail... I was hoping to get one for Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're looking for something for Saki?
In that case...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How about some of these colorful comfits? They look like little stars.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
And they're very cute! Excellent idea!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
I think I'll get some for Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How adorable is it going to be when they have these together with their friends?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...!
A harmonious scene indeed!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... Thank goodness... Saki's going to get a real gift...
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, that should do it for souvenirs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I see a Japanese sweet shop up ahead. Shall we take a break there?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Hehe. I can't wait to see what they have♪ Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-Where'd Shizuku go?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What?!
This is terrible...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It is...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, because she's—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Oh, this is so lovely...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
There she is!

rows.Speaker: Old Store Clerk
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll look very good on you, miss.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
But this looks so well made... I'm not sure I can afford it...

rows.Speaker: Old Store Clerk
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're in for a nice surprise.
I make these as a part of my hobby.
How does this much sound?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, my allowance can cover that...!
Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Old Store Clerk
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku!
Again, your phone has no power, so losing sight of you immediately turns into a big emergency!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's prone to getting lost?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...
Her sense of direction leaves something to be desired...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
I found something wonderful that really caught my attention...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Something wonderful?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, what a lovely haori.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: These snowflakes... They've been embroidered so carefully onto this white fabric...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's also what I liked about it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's really pretty... But when are you gonna wear it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was thinking of using it as a bed jacket since I'm not sure when I'd wear this outside.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
R-Really?! A bed jacket?!
This looks way too nice for that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: W-Would that be bad?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, but...
I guess that does suit you best.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we're all back together, let's head over to that sweet shop!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right!
And after that, we can head over to the shrine for the performing arts!
Shrine for the Performing Arts

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, we're here!
And still all together...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, shall we go make our wishes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay!
Ready, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will!!! Become!!! The world's greatest star!!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Who shouts like that while making their wish?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Th-That was alarming...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree... I'm used to this in your case, but I doubt many people shout out their wishes the way you did...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
W-Wait, but...!
I need to be loud if I want this shrine's deity to hear me, no?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Th-They probably felt your presence...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe... Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
It's just... Tsukasa really hasn't changed since we were little.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Actually, Hinomori...
How long have you two known each other?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't ask you that. It seems like you two have known each other forever...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've known Tsukasa since we were in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, you're childhood friends?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Actually...
We didn't play that often together, but I suppose we're something like that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that seems fair.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I first met him when we were in second grade...
Shrine for the Performing Arts

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were actually in the same elementary school from first grade...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we hardly ever spoke since we were in different classes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, after Shii enrolled, she and Tsukasa's little sister, Saki, became best friends. I remember them going over to each others' houses quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And whenever Shii left something at Saki's house, Tsukasa would always bring it back for her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We began talking more with each passing visit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see.
Shiho and Saki were essentially behind all this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's interesting how your siblings helped build your relationship.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Shizuku and I were in separate classes right through the sixth grade, so we didn't really play together...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But now, we're good friends, with Saki acting as our liaison from time to time!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki does mean the world to you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, isn't that so sweet?
He always places her needs first!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but he isn't nice only to her...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: He's always been cheerful, energetic and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: An incredibly kind friend.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Tsukasa, do you remember what happened when we were fourth graders?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
When we were fourth graders?
Hmmm... What happened back then?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were at the park one time and everyone got into an argument over whether I should play tag or hide and seek...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I remember!
The girls wanted you to play tag with them, but the boys demanded that you play hide and seek.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Children squabble over the silliest things.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, what ended up happening?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Tsukasa just happened to be passing by and stepped in to help.

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, what are you all arguing about?!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Tag or hide and seek? Is that what this is about?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmmm... I know!
This is the perfect time to do...a show!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Just bear with me!
It'll be titled...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is how we ended up doing a show called “Tagland & Hidenseekia”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Tagland and...?
What was it about exactly?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's the tale of how a wandering traveler brokers a peace agreement between the rivaling nations of Tagland and Hidenseekia.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds intriguing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When I first proposed the idea, everyone booed me for not choosing between tag or hide and seek and rattling on about this “show” business...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, after I began performing, they quickly followed suit. Through my show, we all had a chance to play both games!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After that, Tsukasa said how he was glad my friends and I were also able to come to an understanding...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That was when I realized just how much you care about your friends.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
You give me far too much credit!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you're so cheerful, brave, quick-witted...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, go on!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Patient, honest... And so hard-working that you stayed after school to practice doing back hip circles.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: N-Now I'm starting to feel embarrassed. Especially about that last part...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What's this?
Even Tsukasa can feel embarrassed over being complimented?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Show me a little humanity, will you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, she's right...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He cares deeply about his friends.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, Rui, congratulations!
I hope you and your new friends have a fun trip!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You've made some wonderful new friends, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa doesn't stand to benefit from me becoming friends with some of my classmates...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(No, wait...
That's the wrong way to look at it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Seeing that his friends are happy in turn makes him happy.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
As fun as this conversation has been, the time for the parade is fast approaching! We should get going!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Agreed.
I'll let Miyake and the others know that we'll be making our way over.
Hyakki Yako Parade Venue

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Look at this crowd!
Try to stick close, okay, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right! I'll be right behind you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You two said you're trying to meet with Kamishiro's friends. Do you think you'll be able to find them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I believe so.
Based on this message, they should be...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, there you all are.
I'm glad we found you so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Yeah! I mean, this crowd's huge!
Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: K-Kamishiro, those girls behind you. Aren't they...?!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Yeah, they look familiar for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Is it just me or is that Shizuku Hinomori...? And Airi Momoi? Who're they with? She's really pretty...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, they're friends of Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We bumped into each other earlier and decided to invite them to see the parade with us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you must be the friends they were talking about. It's nice to meet you. My name is Shizuku Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing the parade with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
T-Tenma...!
You're amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Did I do something?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
...!
I-I-I-It's our pleasure! Albeit for a short while!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that you've had a chance to introduce yourselves, let's find a place with a good view!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Right.
Shall we, everyone?
Hyakki Yako Parade Venue

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This really is such a large crowd...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It is one of this season's most famous events. As such, tourists from all over flock to see it, including us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... Based on this flyer...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The general participants appear first, then people wearing costumes and stuff designed by professionals.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you can even join on the day by renting a costume...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?! Is that true?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Unfortunately, that may be difficult.
I just saw a sign towards the entrance that said, “All costumes have been rented out.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, darn it...!
If only I paid closer attention to what that website said...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I feel the same way...
We could've all been in it...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure I would've wanted to...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: But I kinda wish you guys could be in it, Kamishiro! I bet it'd be great!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree.
The parade would be guaranteed to be more fun if Tsukasa and Kamishiro were able to participate.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I feel even more regretful about not being able to take part...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But the rules are the rules...
So, let's just enjoy it as regular tourists!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At the same time, that's going to be hard with this many people around. I feel we should move somewhere less crowded...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then... How about over there?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Try to stay together, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, let's—

rows.Speaker: Parade Participants
rows.Line:
Excuse us!
Heavy load coming through!

rows.Speaker: Nice Old Lady
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
They're going to hit that old lady...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: K-Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Nice Old Lady
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you for protecting me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I'm just glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But it's not safe here. There's far too many people... We need to find somewhere less crowded to take refuge—)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (My phone...! I dropped it...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Oh no, it cracked.
But this old lady takes priority right now...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you hurt, Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hinomori...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Madam, would you like us to help you move somewhere less crowded? If we can get back to the main boulevard...

rows.Speaker: Nice Old Lady
rows.Line: No, that's okay. My friend should be waiting for me just over there. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That's a relief...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But please be careful. This crowd is making even walking difficult.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank goodness she ended up being okay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm just as glad.
Now, we should get back to...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, where did Airi and the others go...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Did we get separated from them...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We need to contact them and...
...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's no use.
The touch screen on my phone's unresponsive after I dropped it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wh-What should we do...?!
My phone has no battery left...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wait, I know!
We can look for a place to charge it!
Any convenience store should do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Let's look for one while keeping our ears open for Tsukasa's voice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may just hear him shouting our names somewhere along the way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui!!!
Shizuku!!!
Where are you two?!?!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Kamishiro!
Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi & Taniyama
rows.Line: Where are you?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Say something if you can hear us!!
Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think our voices are being drowned out by the music and all these other people...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
To think that they're unable to hear my booming voice...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We can't reach Shizuku because her phone has no charge, but I don't understand why we can't get ahold of Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I don't know either...
I hope they weren't swept away somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are they going to be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, that sound...
I think the parade is about to begin...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not good...! Once it starts, more people will gather to watch it! That's only gonna make it harder for us to find them...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We need to locate them now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, their safety is a top priority...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But this is also our school trip.
Our goal is to watch this parade together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let's keep looking for them!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu & Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi!
Asahina!
Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi—
*Cough*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes... It's just my throat...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's stop here. You shouldn't overstrain your voice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
Still, now that the parade is underway, it seems like there are more people here. What if we can't find the others?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, but...
Won't it become easier to find them after it's over?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After it's over...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Yes, she's right...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You only get one chance in life as a high schooler to go on this trip! It's like a one-night-only performance!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: But it would be nice to have you in our group, Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you mind if we resumed our search?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A school trip... It's akin to a one-night-only performance...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If possible, I'd like to see the finale as a complete group.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, me too...
You're exactly right, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd also like to create as many wonderful memories as I can with everyone. And more importantly...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi and the others are very likely still trying their best to find us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you're probably right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, should be doing the same!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Agreed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But shouting may not be doing us any good since this crowd seems to be drowning us out...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If only there were a better way for us to get Tsukasa and the others to notice us...

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Whoa!
That nurikabe looks so real!

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Same with that nurarihyon...
Their makeup looks professionally done.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, the costumes...

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Cool! Check out that red ogre!
It totally stands out with that giant club!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It stands out...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Last call for joining the parade with your own costume!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's it...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hinomori, I have an idea, but I need your help.
Would you mind hearing me out?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?
Hyakki Yako Parade Venue

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you see them anywhere?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, I'm not seeing them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
The parade seems to be about half over.
At this rate...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: I guess we're not gonna be able to watch it together...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, don't give up...!
It's not over yet! If we just keep looking...

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Wow...!
What is that?! It's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Wait, it's snowing!
But just around that girl...!
How are they doing that?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's snowing...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How's that possible...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey...!
Isn't that Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
I don't believe it...
That girl with the white haori looks like a real yuki-onna...

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line: I can't believe they're getting it to snow!

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line: Wait, she looks familiar... Where have I seen her before...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, Hinomori. Ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Just like Kamishiro said. Raise your right arm and...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Now! Full power!)

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Whoa!
She's making more snow!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perfect...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Please, everyone! It's us...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
I should expect no less from our director! Bravo!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't forget about Shizuku!
That frosty look on her face... It's like she's the real thing!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
It's certainly hard to miss them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui! Shizuku!
We're over here!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Kamishiro, I see Tsukasa and the others...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I just saw them as well!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll wait for you guys at the end!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have to say, Rui, your idea was spectacular!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't think any of us were expecting you to make yourselves seen like that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, not only was it unexpected, but you had all the other onlookers completely captivated.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
You totally blew everyone away!
You really are a genius, Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel honored.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, if all eyes were really on us...

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line: I wasn't really sure when she walked past us, but isn't that Shizuku Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's gotta be her!
Wanna go say hi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...!
This could get messy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonsense. All we have to do is use this crowd for cover.

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line:
Next!
Here come the professionals!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, let's enjoy this parade together!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! I don't think these count as costumes anymore! They look like real spirits from folklore!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, they're very realistic.
I believe they're inspired by namahage.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Those ogres look absolutely amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That rokurokubi...! Her neck just keeps growing longer and longer! How are they doing that...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Her head looks way too real!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That person dressed as a tengu must have incredible balance. Their sandals look like stilts...

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Whoa, it's a kuchisake-onna...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Imagine seeing one of those at night! I bet we'd all scream while running for our lives!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Haha. I'm not sure we'd be that scared...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Am I pretty...?”

rows.Speaker: Miyake, Hayashi & Taniyama
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: That was you, Kamishiro...?!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Geez, you really got us!
Miyake even fell over!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Th-That was mean, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
My apologies.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Rui, look!
The floats are coming! This must be the finale!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's like a climactic scene!
All those spirits...! And only I, Tsukasa Tenma the Spirit Busting High Schooler can defeat them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. In Kyoto no less.
That certainly sounds like a fun action-adventure story.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Oh, and that black tengu would be the final boss! No, he'd be my enemy at first, but later my ally...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I came...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Because I wouldn't have been able to see this event with them if I hadn't.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that, our school trip is the only reason we did anything together at all.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, for now...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I should enjoy this one-night-only performance.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I guess that's it for today...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, quite a lot happened along the way, but it ended up being a wonderful day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for having us, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: N-No... We should be the ones thanking you. You made the day just that much better.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree!
What we experienced today will surely remain in our album of memories for years to come!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our album...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe so too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll see you all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How about we take a group photo together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A group photo?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'd like to have something to commemorate this day with.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like that as well!
Oh, but my phone's battery is still...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, we can use mine!
I'll see if one of the staff can take it for us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Why this all of a sudden, Rui...?
You never usually suggest doing anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I know.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I thought it'd be nice to for a change.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I agree!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Bunch together you guys!
Get ready!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Okay, everyone!
Say, “Cheese!”
Inn

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I hope you're ready, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. I could say the same for you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Alright, take your positions!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: For tonight's final pillow fight, we have Tenma versus Kamishiro! Gentlemen, let's rumble!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*
se_event_pandemonium_2023_001
se_event_pandemonium_2023_002
se_event_pandemonium_2023_003

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, a triple throw right out of the gates! Unfortunately for you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I watched what you did against Miyake, so that's not going to work on me!
se_event_pandemonium_2023_005
se_event_pandemonium_2023_006
se_event_pandemonium_2023_007

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
What?!
He dodged them?! By spinning?!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Cool!
Go Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
H-Hey, you guys...
If you break any of the inn's stuff, you're automatically disqualified!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: The first to get hit five times loses, but this is probably gonna take a while...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now it's my turn!
Let's see how you deal with a pillow bombing!
se_event_pandemonium_2023_004

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
He just threw all the pillows into the air...!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Wait, that means...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
They're gonna hit us!
Wah!
se_event_pandemonium_2023_008
se_event_pandemonium_2023_009

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph... That was clever, but I narrowly avoided all of them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, impressive...
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
What's the big idea, Kamishiro...?
Those landed right on top of us...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Yeah, what he said!
We're fighting for Tenma now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I thought we were supposed to fight as individuals. Three versus one seems a bit unfair, no?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah!
We decided from the start that it should be one-on-one...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No matter...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Miyake, you're my last hope.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Huh?!
What do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, you fight even though you're outnumbered! That is commendable! Comrades, prepare for battle!!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi & Taniyama
rows.Line: Roger!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe... We may be fewer in number, but we still plan on winning. I hope you're prepared to have your confidence shattered.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, victory shall be ours!
Attaaack...!!!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
W-Wait, stop!
If we fight all at once—
se_event_pandemonium_2023_012

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Boys, it's past curfew!
What's going on here?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: I knew this would happen...
Teacher's Room

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
That's two nights in a row.
I'll be asking for letters of apology from each of you.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Come get me once you've finished writing them. I'll escort you back to your rooms after that.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Honestly, does the Weirdo Wombo Combo ever learn...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr...!
How could I have made such a foolish mistake...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not only am I a class representative, I am a future star! I'm supposed to lead by example, but I've been scolded two days in a row by the teachers!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we did go a little too far back there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, this has all been so new for me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: New?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, between our pillow fight...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ...sightseeing with everyone...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ...getting separated, reuniting with everyone and seeing the parade together...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
They all felt like new experiences.
It felt like I was working on a show. That sort of wonderment...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm so glad that I got to spend this time with you and the others today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I have you to thank, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Miyake actually mentioned something earlier...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Today was so much fun. I'm glad you decided to join our group, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You are?
Hehe. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Of course.
I got to know you a little better, and...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: To tell you the truth...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: When you first transferred to our school, Rui, you always seemed to have fun tinkering with your drones and stuff at your desk...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: But there were also times when you looked really bored.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That apparently made him think that he had better not disturb me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But then, he said that I began smiling more after I began spending more time with you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a result, he decided that he wanted to get to know me better.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe it's evidence of just how much I've changed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How about we take a group photo together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A group photo?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'd like to have something to commemorate this day with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa was right in saying that I never usually make such suggestions.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I probably said that because the time we spent together is so precious to me.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The old me was convinced that I'd never be able to actually get along with anyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that began to change after we started doing shows together at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, I don't need shows or anything to get to know someone. On top of that, I want to share smiles and laughter with them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, Tsukasa...
Thank you for giving me the opportunity to change the way I have.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The only response I can give right now is, “You're welcome!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still...
I don't think I deserve all the credit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Think about it, Rui. If you were firmly against changing, then it wouldn't have mattered what I did. Things would've remained the way they were.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, you wanted to be a part of a group, and you've been having fun as a result.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And that has nothing to do with me...
You're here today because that's what you chose.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, there's something else that I need to ask you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why are you talking like everything's in the past already?! Our trip is not yet over!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We should keep having fun until we all have to go home!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means we should go over once more what we'll be doing tomorrow. How does an early-morning walk along the Kamo River sound? Don't worry, I'll ask the teachers for permission.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, that sounds splendid!
We can watch the sunrise while we're there! What a way to spend our youth! Saki will surely enjoy hearing about it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Also!
We should try skipping stones!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Skipping stones...?
Oh, when you try to get flat rocks to bounce across water?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, have you never tried?
Okay, watch! You hold it like this and flick your wrist!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe... Your form seems a bit odd.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What do you mean?!
You can get stones to skip endlessly by doing this! Skip! Skip! Skip! Oh...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Tenma! What's all this about?! “Skip! Skip! Skip!”?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Argh!
What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: You didn't think anyone would hear you shouting?! Also, where's that letter of apology I asked for?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nooo, I'm sorry!
It slipped my mind while talking with Rui here...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: But it looks like he already wrote his.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
R-Rui, how?! When...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I finished writing it before you came to talk to me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: T-Traitor...!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Finish writing it already, Tenma!
There's a teachers-only party that I'm not about to miss!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: O-Okay, I will!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. Sorry, Tsukasa...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But this is also going in my album of precious memories.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa's given me so many reasons to smile.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which has in turn allowed me to make new friends and establish new connections.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wonder what the future has in store for me next...
